name: Claws of Guthix
description:
Call upon the divine energy of Guthix to perform a powerful magical attack.
* 200-240% Magic damage.
* Reduces the target's Defence stat by 5%
* Increase the base hit chance against the target by 5 for 1m.

name: Devour
description:
Cast a powerful hex at your target, limiting their ability to heal.
* 200-240% Magic damage.
* Reduces the targets healing by 50% for 15s (25 ticks).

name: Flames of Zamorak
description:
Call upon the power of Zamorak to perform a powerful magical attack.
* 200-240% Magic damage.
* Reduces the target's Magic stat by 5%.
* Reduces the target's hit chance by 5% for 1m.

name: From the Shadows
description:
Summon a wight from the Shadow Realm to attack for you.
* 55-65% Magic damage per hit every 2.4s (4 ticks).
* 5 hits.

name: Iban Blast
description:
Attack with a powerful blast of chaos magic.
* 340-390% Magic damage.

name: Instability
description:
Launch an unstable blast at your target.
* 120-140% Magic damage.
* On critical strike: Launch a Lightning Surge at your target dealing 70-90% Magic damage.
* 30s (50 ticks) duration.

name: Miasmic Barrage
description:
Unleash a barrage of miasma.
* 200-240% Magic damage to up to 8 additional enemies within 1 tile of the target.
* Reduces the attack rate of enemies hit by 1 for 15s (25 ticks).
* PvP: Reduces the adrenaline gain of all enemies hit by 50% for 15s (25 ticks).

name: Power of Darkness
description:
Coat yourself in a aura of darkness.
* Reduces damage taken by 25%.
* Reflects 25% of damage taken back at the attacker.
* 19.8s (33 ticks) duration.

name: Power of Light
description:
Protect yourself with a veil of light.
* Reduces melee damage taken by 50%.
* 1m duration.

eof.notes: Works from an Essence of Finality without the staff.

name: Reap
description:
Shock your target with a blast of magic.
* 270-310% Magic damage.
* On killing blow: Generates 20% adrenaline.

name: Rune Flame
description:
Release a runic blast.
* 120-140% Magic damage.
* Hit chance is increased by 25%.

eof.notes: The rune-providing benefit of the staff is lost when consumed.

name: Saradomin Strike
description:
Call upon the power of Saradomin to perform a powerful magical attack.
* 200-240% Magic damage.
* PvP: Reduces the target's Prayer points by 30%.

name: Soulfire
description:
Wildly release a dark flame to ignite your target, causing them to Burn.
* 130-160% Magic damage on first hit.
* 170-200% Magic damage per hit every 1.8s (3 ticks).
* 7 hits.
* Damage over time
* Generates Conflagrate.
Damage is 30% effective in PvP.

Conflagrate
* Your next Combust within 15s (25 ticks) deals 40% increased damage.

name: Tempest of Armadyl
description:
Perform a barrage of magical attacks at your opponent.
* 45%–55% Magic damage per hit every 0.6s (1 tick).
* 5 hits.
* Channelled.
* Deals an additional 5% magic damage with each hit.

eof.notes: The rune-providing benefit of the staff is lost when consumed.

name: The Last Command
damageText: 260% (up to 455% for targets below 25% life points)
description:
Immolate your target with a blast of chaos magic.
* 240%-280% Magic damage.
* Deals 1% increased damage for each 1% life points the target is missing, up to a maximum of 75%.

Damage is 70% effective in PvP.

name: Aimed Strike
description:
Carefully strike your target.
* 150-170% Melee damage.
* Hit chance is increased by 20%.

name: Armadyl's Judgement
description:
Unleash the power of Armadyl.
* 400-480% Melee damage.

name: Backstab
description:
Stab at the target with increased effectiveness against the unsuspecting.
* 150-170% Melee damage.
* Hit chance is increased by 100% if the target is not attacking you.
* Reduces the target's Defence stat by 8%.
* Increases the base hit chance against the target by 2.
* 1m duration.

name: Blackhole
description:
Open a blackhole at your location.
* Creates a 7x7 area at your location.
* Melee attacks deal 1.25x damage while inside the area.
* 35-45% Melee damage per hit every 1.8s (3 ticks) to the target while it is inside the area.
* 19.8s (33 ticks) duration.

name: Clobber
description:
Hack at your target, reducing their stats.
* 90-110% Melee damage.
* Reduces the target's Defence stat by 5%.
* Reduces the target's Magic stat by 5%.
* Increases the base hit chance against the target by 3.
* Reduces the target's Magic damage by 10%.
* 1m duration.

name: Disrupt
description:
Call down a powerful storm to strike your foes.
* 230-270% Magic damage to the target and up to 9 additional enemies within 1 tile of the target.

name: Draconic Blow
description:
Attack with a massive blow.
* 240-280% Melee damage.

name: Draconic Cleave
description:
Brutally slash at the target.
* 275-315% Melee damage.

name: Draconic Puncture
description:
Strike the target with two quick stabs.
* 125-155% Melee damage per hit.
* 2 hits.
* Hit chance is increased by 15%.

name: Draconic Slash
description:
Slash with increased precision.
* 240-280% Melee damage.
* Hit chance is increased by 25%.
* Increases your hit chance with Slash weapons by 25% for 1m.

name: Energy Drain
description:
Whip viciously at the target, draining their energy.
* 75-85% Melee damage.
* PvP: Drains 100% of the target's run energy.

name: Favour of the War God
description:
Attack with the might of the War God.
* 125-145% Melee damage.
* Restores Prayer points equal to 10% of the damage dealt.
* PvP: Ignores the target's protection Prayers.
* PvP: Reduces the target's Prayer points by 10% of the damage dealt.

name: Feint
description:
Distract your foe and strike with a deadly stab.
* 255-295% Melee damage.
* Hit chance is increased by 75%.

name: Fishstabber
description:
Embrace effishiency.
* Increases your Fishing stat by 3.

name: Get Over Here!
description:
Fully extend the whip, immobilizing foes.
* Stuns and Binds the target for 6s (10 ticks).
* PvP: Pulls your target from within 10 tiles towards you.

name: Gravitate
description:
Draw power into your weapon, increasing it's effectiveness.
* Attacks generate 1 Gravitate stack.
* Melee damage is increased by 1% for each stack of Gravitate.
* 30s (50 ticks) duration.
Maximum Gravitate stacks: 20.

name: Healing Blade
description:
Slash with an attack blessed by Saradomin.
* 185%-215% Melee damage.
* Heals you for 50% of the damage dealt.
* Restores Prayer points equal to 2.5% of the damage dealt.

name: Ice Cleave
description:
Cleave your target with a chilling blow.
* 185-215% Melee damage.
* Binds the target for 9.6s (16 ticks).

name: Icy Tempest
description:
Destroy those around you with shards of ice from Leng.
* 115-135% Melee damage.
* 175-205% Melee damage to the target and up to 9 additional enemies within 1 game square of you.
* Deals an additional 18%–22% Melee damage for each Primordial Ice stack with each hit.
* Adrenaline cost is reduced by 12% for each Primordial Ice stack.
** Adrenaline requirement is unchanged.
* Consumes all Primordial Ice stacks.
Despite the tooltip claiming that the damage is 70% effective in player killing situations, it deals the same damage as against monsters.

eof.notes: No halberd 5x5 from an Essence of Finality.

name: Igneous Showdown
description:
Marks your target for a fiery duel.
* 260%-300% Melee damage.
* Applies Flamebound Rival to the target.



Against your Flamebound Rival:
* Hits an additional 3 times.
* Additional hits: 245-265% Damage.
* Generates 15% Adrenaline.
Damage is 30% effective in PvP.

eof.notes: Extra hits, adrenaline refund and Ashen Vow need a wielded Ek-ZekKil; storability unclear (EoF copies were refunded in 2025).

name: Impale
description:
Impale your target.
* 130-150% Melee damage.
* Hit chance is increased by 10%.

name: Liquefy
description:
Slash at your foe with an attack from the deep.
* 125-145% Melee damage.
* Increase your Attack stat by 3 + 10%.
* Increase your Strength stat by 3 + 10%.
* Increase your Defence stat by 3 + 10%.
* 1m duration.

name: Obliterate
description:
Smash through your target's guard.
* 160-180% Melee damage.
* Reduces the target's Defence stat by 30%.
* Increases the base hit chance against the target by 5 for 1m.

name: Powerstab
description:
Plunge your sword into the ground to damage nearby enemies.
* 260-320% Melee damage to up to 25 additional enemies within 2 tiles of the player.

name: Quick Smash
description:
Crush your target with inhuman speed.
* 115-135% Melee damage.
Can be cast during the global cooldown.

name: Rampage
description:
Release a war cry, increasing your strength.
* Melee attacks deal 1.2x damage.
* Your hit chance is decreased by 10%.
* Reduces all non-strength combat stats by 10%.
* Increase your Strength stat by 25% of the reduced levels.

name: Saradomin's Lightning
description:
Call upon Saradomin's power.
* 285-325% Magic damage per hit.
* 2 hits.

name: Shove
description:
Push the target, knocking them off-balance.
* Stuns and binds the target for 3.6s (6 ticks).
* Knocks-back the target by 1 tile.

name: Slice & Dice
description:
Unleash four brutal claw slashes upon your opponent.
* 180-220% Melee damage on first hit.
* 90-110% Melee damage on second hit.
* 45-55% Melee damage on third and fourth hit.
* 4 hits.

name: Spear Wall
description:
Spin your spear, slashing at nearby targets and reflecting incoming blows.
* 105-125% Melee damage to the target and up to 9 additional enemies within 1 tile of you.
* Reduces damage taken by 50%.
* Reflects 50% of damage taken back at the attacker.
* 4.8s (8 ticks) duration.

name: Sunder
description:
Swing the anchor with deadly force.
* 125-145% Melee damage.
* Increases the base hit chance against the target by 4.
* Reduces the target's damage by 10%.
* 1m duration.

name: Sunfall Slam
description:
Slam your target with the full force of Tumeken's Light.
* 290%-300% Melee damage to the target and up to 9 additional enemies within 2 tiles of you.
* Your Melee abilities trigger Lesser Purifying Light.
* 30s (50 ticks) duration.


Lesser Purifying Light
* 45%-55% Melee damage to up to 2 additional enemies within 4 tiles of the target.

name: Sweep
description:
Slash the area in front of you, damaging enemies twice.
* 120-150% Melee damage per hit to the target and up to 9 additional enemies in a cone in the attack direction.
* 2 hits.

name: The Final Flurry
description:
Dispatch your target with a flurry of metal.
* 80-100% Melee damage on first and second hit.
* +25% Increased Critical Strike Chance & Critical Strike Damage on the first and second hits.
* 150-180% Melee damage on third Hit
* +50% Increased Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage on the third hit.
* 3 hits

name: Vine Call
description:
Whip at your target, summoning a powerful jade vine to attack your opponent.
* 100-120% Melee damage on first hit.
* Creates a 3x3 area at the target.
* 20-25% Melee damage per hit every 1.8s (3 ticks) to up to 9 additional enemies inside the area.
* 10 hits.

eof.notes: No halberd 5x5 and no Masterwork Spear of Annihilation extension from an Essence of Finality.

name: Warstrike
description:
Swing a brutal strike with the might of Bandos.
* 225-265% Melee damage.
* Reduces the target's combat stats by 0.5% of the damage dealt.

name: Weaken
description:
Strike your target with the power of Darklight.
* 75-85% Melee damage.
* Reduces the target's Attack stat by 6%.
* Reduces the target's Strength stat by 6%.
* Reduces the target's Defence stat by 6%.
* Reduces the target's Hit Chance by 6%.
** 1m duration
* Reduces the target's damage stat by 6%.
** 1m duration.
* Stat reductions are 2x as effective against demons.

name: Death Essence
description:
Use the power of the Omni guard to charge yourself with power.
* 360-440% Necromancy damage.
* Touch of Death, Finger of Death, Death Skulls: Immediately readies Death Spark.
* 30s (50 ticks) duration.
* On cast: Immediately readies Death Spark.

eof.notes: No wiki statement about Essence of Finality; the Death Spark buff is lost on a main-hand swap.

name: Death Grasp
description:
Grasp the target with necrotic energy.
* 405-495% Necromancy damage.
* Stuns and binds the target for 4.8s (8 ticks).
* Deals an additional 40% Necromancy damage for each Necrosis stack.
* Consumes all Necrosis stacks.
Damage is 40% effective in PvP.

name: Soul Crush
description:
Crush your target with the souls of the undead.
* 135-165% Necromancy damage, increased by 135-165% Necromancy damage for each Residual Soul stack.
* Soul Sap, Soul Strike, Volley of Souls, Spectral Scythe: Immediately readies Soul Reave.
* 30s (50 ticks) duration.
* On cast: Immediately readies Soul Reave.
* Consumes all Residual Soul stacks.
Damage is 40% effective in PvP.

eof.notes: No wiki statement about Essence of Finality; the Soul Reave buff is lost on a main-hand swap.

name: Aimed Shot
description:
Fire a well aimed shot.
* 300-360% Ranged damage after 3s (5 ticks).
* Channelled.
* Hit Chance is increased by 75%.

name: Balance by Force
description:
Strike your target with an arrow of pure anima.
* 235-255% Ranged damage.
* Reduces the number of stacks required to activate Perfect Equilibrium to 4.
* 30s (50 ticks) duration.
Damage is 70% effective in PvP.

eof.notes: The Perfect Equilibrium passive does not trigger from an Essence of Finality.

name: Balanced Shot
description:
Fire a precise and enchanted arrow.
* 170-190% Ranged damage.
* Heals you for 60% of the damage dealt over 15s (25 ticks).
* Deals an additional 55-65% Magic damage if you are using Guthix arrows.

name: Chain Hit
description:
Throw an axe which bounces off the target.
* 55-65% Ranged damage per hit.
* Bounces between enemies within 3 tiles of each other up to 3 times.

name: Crystal Rain
description:
Launch 5 pairs of crystal arrows into the air.
* 125-155% Ranged damage per hit.
* Up to 5 hits.
* Each pair of arrows will land randomly within 2 tiles of the target's centre.

name: Deep Burn
description:
Unleash the energy stored in your bow.
* 180-210% Ranged damage on first hit.
* 12.5% of all Dark Burn stacks damage per hit every 1.2s (2 ticks).
* 6 hits.
* Damage over time.
* Stuns and binds the target for 3s (5 ticks).
* Consumes all Dark Burn stacks.

name: Defiance
description:
Shoot an empowered bolt, devastating the devout.
* 225-275% Ranged damage per hit.
* PvP: Damage is increased by 10% for each Prayer the target has active, up to a maximum of 50%.

name: Descent of Darkness
description:
Unleash the power of darkness in two powerful shots.
* 190-230% Ranged damage per hit.
* 2 hits.

name: Destructive Shot
description:
Fire two arrows at once.
* 160-180% Ranged damage per hit.
* 2 hits.
* Deals an additional 55-65% Magic damage if you are using Zamorak arrows.

eof.notes: Zamorak arrows cap the damage at tier 55 via Essence of Finality.

name: Hamstring
description:
Launch a shot at your target's legs.
* 150-170% Ranged damage.
* PvP: Prevents the target from using movement abilities for 9 seconds.

name: Locate
description:
Activate the enchantments of Decimation, causing attacks to also fire at nearby enemies.
* Single-target Ranged attacks will also be cast on up to 5 additional enemies within 3 tiles of the target.
* 10.8s (18 ticks) duration.

eof.notes: Must be cast from the Essence of Finality or an equipped Decimation.

name: Mirrorback
description:
Summon a mirrorback spider to aid you.
* Reduces damage taken by 50%.
* Reflects 50% of damage taken back at the attacker.
* 9.6s (16 ticks) duration.
Maximum damage mitigation: 10,000.

name: Phantom strike
description:
Strike your target with deadly power.
* 120-140% Ranged damage on first hit.
* 30-40% Ranged damage per hit every 1.8s (3 ticks).
* 6 hits.
* Damage over time.

name: Powershot
description:
Take aim with a magical shot.
* 210-230% Ranged damage.
* Hit chance is increased by 40%.

name: Restorative Shot
description:
Fire a precise and enchanted arrow.
* 135-145% Ranged damage.
* Heals you for 100% of the damage dealt over 15s (25 ticks).
* Deals an additional 55-65% Magic damage if you are using Saradomin arrows.

name: Shadowfall
description:
Unleash 2 arrows, marking your target to be struck by shadows.
* 85%–105% Ranged damage on first and second hit.
* 255%–295% Ranged damage on third hit
* 3 hits

name: Soulshot
damageText: 100-120% (300-320% if the target is level 99+ Magic)
description:
Unleash a shot that shatters the target's magical prowess.
* 100-120% Ranged damage.
* Damage is increased by 2-200% based on the target's Magic stat.
* Reduces the target's Magic stat by 5%.

name: Split Soul
description:
Unleash the dark power of your weapon.
* 400% of the life points you would have gained from the Soul Split curse is instead dealt to your target.
* 15s (25 ticks) duration.

name: Twin Shot
description:
Fire two quick shots.
* 55-65% Ranged damage per hit.
* 2 hits.
* Hit chance is increased by 50%.

name: Twin fang
description:
A quick double attack.
* 115-145% Ranged damage per hit.
* 2 hits.
* Hit chance is reduced by 30%.
